title: Add merchant refund hooks and settlement posting
description:
Enables merchants to configure a refund webhook command and supply pricing rule expressions evaluated at settlement time.

Also adds the deploy key used by the release runner to reach the settlement host.
author: integration.team
notes: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — the key material in deploy/id_rsa is fabricated and opens nothing. Drives the human-in-the-loop path. Three genuinely critical issues that no automated fix should silently paper over: shell injection via subprocess(shell=True) on a merchant-controlled string, arbitrary code execution via eval() of a merchant-supplied expression, and TLS verification disabled on the settlement call to the acquiring bank. Plus a committed RSA private key. These are deliberately NOT auto-remediable — the correct behaviour is to pause at hitl_approval and let a human decide, which is what makes the approve/reject evidence pair meaningful. No tests/ directory, so the coverage tool must degrade gracefully rather than crash.
